instrument: FERC order rejecting ComEd's notice of cancellation of the PowerHouse Hillwood transmission security agreement (Joliet, IL; ~Sept 22, 2026)
summary: FERC rejected ComEd's cancellation of a transmission security agreement for a 1.8 GW, ~$20 billion data center in Joliet and declined primary jurisdiction, leaving the dispute to federal district court in Illinois. PowerHouse says it met initial credit requirements by posting $1. Concurrences by Chairman Swett and Commissioner See (pro forma cost-recovery agreements), Commissioner LaCerte and Commissioner Rosner (properly sized security deposits).
notes: ComEd's stated reason for cancelling TSAs: underlying retail service applications withdrawn; 4 of ComEd's first 8 TSAs cancelled. RTO/ISO show-cause responses due mid-November. Candidate large-load security field; compare Kansas LLPS collateral.
confidence_note: Order and concurrences not read (FERC eLibrary).
